name: Carrion Defense Works Field Surgical Kit FSK-6
product_name: Carrion Defense Works Field Surgical Kit FSK-6
description: A comprehensive surgical kit designed for emergency field operations — containing scalpels, hemostats, retractors, suture materials, a compact cauterizer, bone saw, and a diagnostic scanner for guiding procedures without imaging equipment. The FSK-6 is designed for trained field medics performing procedures that cannot wait for evacuation to a medical facility — bullet extraction, internal hemorrhage repair, emergency amputation, and cyberware emergency disconnection. The kit includes Lazarus RWCNS nanite injectors for wound closure and a neural interface link that provides AR-guided surgical assistance overlaid on the operative field.
story_hooks: An FSK-6 was used to perform field surgery on a shooting victim in a Tier 1 hallway — the AR-guided procedure was performed by someone with no formal medical training who followed the overlay instructions perfectly.
A modified FSK-6 has been configured specifically for forced cyberware removal — the AR guide walks an operator through disconnecting and extracting neural interface hardware from a living subject.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Thermal Longsword TL-3 'Cauterizer'
Lazarus Pharmaceuticals Rapid Wound Closure Nanite System

physical_description.visual_profile: A militarized surgical kit housed in a ruggedized hard case with a split-clamshell design. The interior reveals a densely organized foam insert with custom-cut compartments for each instrument. The aesthetic is utilitarian and combat-focused—more field hospital than sterile clinic. The case exterior shows tactical mounting points and a reinforced carry handle. All surfaces are designed for rapid access under stress.
physical_description.dimensions: 45 cm × 28 cm × 12 cm (closed); case roughly briefcase-sized but significantly heavier
physical_description.weight_description: 5 kg in hardened case; requires two-handed carry or shoulder strap for extended transport; easily mounted to tactical vests or med-pack frames
physical_description.primary_material: Shock-absorbent polycarbonate composite case exterior; stainless steel and anodized aluminum surgical instruments; silicone-coated foam interior
physical_description.finish: Matte black tactical finish on case with anti-reflective coating; instruments feature a satin-brushed steel appearance with some black oxide coating for low-light operation; grip surfaces have rubberized texture for bloodied hands
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal black case with crimson emergency stripe along spine; instrument handles in gunmetal gray with crimson accents; Lazarus nanite injectors in translucent amber housings revealing their fluid contents; diagnostic scanner has a dark green display screen
physical_description.interface_elements: Spring-latched compartments; tactile pressure-release locks on nanite injectors; diagnostic scanner with 7-inch holographic display head and neural interface jack (silver crown connector); cauterizer unit has physical dial and grip-friendly trigger; UV sterilization lamp powered by internal battery with LED status indicator (blue when active)
distinctive_features: AR surgical guide interface jack that glows faintly when active—neural link engagement shows as pulsing cyan light
Diagnostic scanner's holographic display projects anatomy overlays directly above the surgical field
Nanite injectors marked with Biohazard ☢ and RWCNS proprietary logo in white lettering
Oscillating bone saw has a red warning stripe and produces a characteristic high-pitch hum when powered
Interior foam is bright medical white with color-coded compartments: red for hemostatic tools, blue for retractors/spreaders, yellow for cautery/electrical, green for nanite delivery
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CARRION DEFENSE WORKS logo stamped in white on case spine; FSK-6 designation laser-etched on interior lid; regulatory stamps including GLMZ Medical Authority approval, warranty void if opened without authorization seal; serial number on underside of case
physical_description.condition_typical: In field use: case exterior shows scuff marks and weathering from tactical environments; instruments may show biological residue despite field sterilization attempts; neural interface port shows minor oxidation from humidity exposure; nanite injectors often partially depleted; diagnostic scanner screen may have fingerprints or dried blood spatter that crews wipe clean between procedures
